Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the screenshot, and sorry for the interruption. I’ve looped Ben from Integrations (cc’d) — he maintains our Zip allowlist guidance. First pass: please have IT allow outbound HTTPS to the following hosts and IP ranges, and whitelist the redirect path /s/accept: 

- zip.redwood.ai (443)
- cdn.redwood-ai.com (443)
- 34.198.12.0/24 (regional CDN)

I’m attaching a short allowlist snippet Ben can confirm.

Also: can you tell me whether your firewall performs SNI or HTTP Host header filtering? That affects whether the IP-range alone will work or if host-level allow is required.

Once IT confirms, I can resend the invite (we’ll rotate the token to clear any cached blocks). If you prefer, we can also provide a direct one-time accept URL via a different host for your IT to test.

Best,
David Kim
Partner Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-allowlist-instructions.txt (text/plain)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Alicia Chang <alicia.chang@stellarsupply.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite link blocked by corporate firewall

Thanks David — adding a couple of troubleshooting notes IT may need: 

- If the firewall does strict Host header/SNI filtering, they must allow zip.redwood.ai by hostname; IP allowlist alone may fail because we use SNI-backed CDN.
- Some enterprise proxies rewrite query strings; ensure they preserve the full path and the invite token parameter (invite_token=...). If query strings are stripped the accept flow will return a 400.
- If they have a web content scanner terminating TLS, our token will still work but the page render can break if JS is blocked. Allowlist the Host and allow inline JS from cdn.redwood-ai.com.

If they want to test without changing firewall rules, we can issue a time-limited accept token on redwood-internal.svc (different edge) for a short window — better for IT to verify connectivity. Let me know which they prefer and I’ll generate the token and a test URL.

-Ben
Principal Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference

Can you confirm that the vendor record is now linked to PO account ST-998 and that we’ll receive the first PO next week? Also please send the AP contact who will appear on the PO.
